description.value: Canada Place Welcome Centre is a tourist information office situated at the landmark Canada Place complex on Vancouver's downtown waterfront. It serves as a visitor orientation point for one of the city's most recognizable destinations, which also functions as a cruise ship terminal and convention venue. Touring cyclists arriving at the waterfront could use it as a starting point for maps and local visitor information.
